warren_entry_ng.speaker: Kella
warren_entry_ng.text: Again. Of course. Well. At least I know where the chest is this time.

warren_entry_ng_all_recruited.speaker: Kella
warren_entry_ng_all_recruited.text: Everyone's waiting for me. Don't blow it this time.

baby_dragon_chest_ng.speaker: Kella
baby_dragon_chest_ng.text: There you are. Hello again, little one.

michael_meeting_ng.speaker: Kella
michael_meeting_ng.text: I know what you're going to say. Say it anyway.

michael_meeting_ng_never.speaker: Kella
michael_meeting_ng_never.text: ...I didn't bring you along last time. I won't make that mistake again.

hannah_catacomb_ng.speaker: Kella
hannah_catacomb_ng.text: I know you're down here. Hang on.

orisia_ng_good_ending.speaker: Kella
orisia_ng_good_ending.text: Last time I helped you. I don't regret it. Ask me again.

orisia_ng_normal_ending.speaker: Kella
orisia_ng_normal_ending.text: We reached a compromise before. Let's see if we can do better.

orisia_ng_bad_ending.speaker: Kella
orisia_ng_bad_ending.text: Last time something else showed up after. I need to be ready for that.

flood_death_ng.speaker: Kella
flood_death_ng.text: No. Not this time. Flood, move.

slaver_island_ng.speaker: Kella
slaver_island_ng.text: Came back to finish it right.

yipp_spawn_ng.speaker: Kella
yipp_spawn_ng.text: Different dungeon this time. Of course.

vampire_meeting_ng.speaker: Kella
vampire_meeting_ng.text: I know what you're going to say about mortals. Skip ahead to the part where you join us.

jerod_preexplosion_ng.speaker: Kella
jerod_preexplosion_ng.text: Jerod. I know what you're planning. Don't.

jerod_preexplosion_ng_response_2.speaker: Jerod
jerod_preexplosion_ng_response_2.text: So you've done this before. Hm.

jerod_preexplosion_ng_kella.speaker: Kella
jerod_preexplosion_ng_kella.text: Not if I can help it.
